Canonical parliamentary prints register: bill texts, memoranda and transitional/effective-date provisions.
Live bill status tracker; the join key between the legislative process and the final Z. z. number.
Finance Committee page is a section of nrsr.sk already covered by the prints/bill trackers, but useful for actor mapping.
Alternate crawl route into the same nrsr.sk documents; value only if the primary registers prove hard to scrape.
Voting search on nrsr.sk pins adoption dates for vacatio legis computation; sub-page of the covered parent.
Video archive is high-cost, low-yield for automated deadline monitoring; occasional evidence only.
Legislative Council mandate/rulebook page — mine once for procedure rules and membership, not a recurring feed.
Tripartite register flags employer/financial-sector objections and timetable slippage on economic-impact bills.
MF SR legislative task plan is a forward calendar of banking/payments amendments before they hit Slov-Lex.
NBS register of decrees/measures links each supervisory instrument to its Z. z. number and effective date.
EU meta-portal documenting the SK legal database; useful once for structure, redundant with Slov-Lex thereafter.
Unmaintained community scraper — mine once for URL patterns; not a signal source and compatibility unverified.
National open-data catalogue: mine once to find machine-readable dumps of bills/votes instead of scraping.
Civic-tech data mirrors may shortcut ingestion, but coverage and continuity for legislative data are unverified.
Useful unofficial consolidated mirror with a new-regulations feed; url_verification failed, so re-check liveness and ToS.
Second commercial mirror largely redundant with Slov-Lex and zakonypreludi; keep only as a diffing fallback.
Law-firm bulletin narrating each banking-act amendment with effective dates — fast triage layer over the gazette.
EUR-Lex NIM database is the authoritative machine-readable record of SK transposition of EU financial directives.
Commission scoreboard quantifies Slovakia's transposition deficit and delay — dated comparative deadline signal.
Infringement page is a sibling section of the same scoreboard site; early warning on late SK transposition.
EBA Single Rulebook and compliance tables state NBS compliance status per guideline, with dated structured PDFs.
Interactive rulebook is a section of the EBA Single Rulebook parent; mine for the obligation/deadline inventory.
Single Rulebook Q&A surfaces SK-origin implementation questions — an indirect read on local compliance friction.
EUCLID PSD2 register gives the SK payment/e-money institution population to which EU deadlines apply.
Monthly ECB supervised-entity list splits SK banks SSM vs NBS; url_verification failed so re-check the exact URL.
ECB CON opinions expose SK draft banking/payments laws pre-adoption with EU-law critique attached.
